toy_1d_guidance_approximation.description: Paper Section 5.1 / Appendix E.1 (Figures 1 and 5, Table 1): how closely a sampling-time guidance rule matches the optimal foresight guidance g* = -sqrt(1 - alpha_bar_t) d/dx_t log E_t(x_t) of the joint-scaling objective, on the paper's 1D DDPM setting as released by the authors (20 steps, betas 1e-4..2e-2, separate conditional/unconditional epsilon networks, q(x|y) = 0.5N(0.5,0.25^2)+0.5N(1.5,0.25^2), q(x) = 0.5N(-2,0.5^2)+0.5N(0,0.5^2) per the released configuration, reward q(x|y)/q(x), g* estimated from stochastic denoising completions). The evaluator runs each rule against frozen denoisers through a counted oracle and compares it with vanilla CFG on the same states. The visible slice uses the paper's mixtures (own denoisers and the authors' released checkpoint) plus public paper-like mixtures; the hidden slice uses hidden paper-like mixtures with their own denoisers.

_paper_reported.note: The paper reports the 1D experiment qualitatively (Figures 1, 5, 6). Its only quantitative low-dimensional numbers are the 2D Table 1 win ratios of REG versus vanilla CFG against the optimal target (REG side, %): class 1 t=20,16,12,8,4: 60.2, 56.7, 67.8, 67.7, 65.5; class 2: 65.2, 68.2, 74.4, 73.1, 72.0; mean 67.08%. That mean is kept below as the reg_cfg win_rate reference; it is a 2D number, so the 1D reproduction is not expected to match it.
_paper_reported.overhead_note: The paper states REG adds one gradient (VJP) computation per guided step on top of the two denoiser passes of CFG; in oracle units that is 2 for CFG and 3 for REG.

guidance_mae.description: Mean absolute difference between the rule's guidance and the optimal foresight guidance g* over all evaluation states (all problems, all 20 time steps); per-state error clipped at 4.

win_rate.description: Fraction of evaluation states where the rule is strictly closer to g* than vanilla classifier-free guidance at scale 1 (computed by the evaluator); ties count one half. The quantity of the paper's Table 1.

worst_timestep_win_rate.description: Minimum over the 20 time steps of the per-step win rate against vanilla CFG (Table 1 reports the win ratio per time step).

worst_problem_mae.description: Largest per-problem guidance MAE across the problems of the slice (robustness across mixtures and denoiser seeds).

oracle_cost_per_state.description: Mean denoiser-evaluation units spent per guided state (forward pass = 1, input derivative = +1), measured by the evaluator. Constraint: no foresight; hard cap of 8 units per state.
